thread:
sam: T-minus 45 until EU quiet window starts (00:00-04:00 UTC). Quick pre-freeze checklist: pins, release notes, rollback plan, and exemption path. @taylor please confirm CANARY pin.
taylor: Release notes pushed to internal changelog: https://redwood.internal/changelog/4985002222. Noted tokenization tweak + minor schema bump.
mike: Pinning router rules and model-service for canary. Plan: /pin model-service v3.4.3-rc2 3h, /pin router canary-route 2h.
deploy-bot: Command accepted -> `/pin service=model-service version=3.4.3-rc2 duration=3h` by mike.
deploy-bot: Command accepted -> `/pin service=router rule=canary-route duration=2h` by mike.
jo: Smoke tests queued against canary group (eu-west-1). Test set: quick-gen, embedding consistency, long-context token stability.
lina: Dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/release/4985002222. Key watches: 5xx rate, p95 latency, embed drift, and tokenization mismatch logs. Alerts set to page on sustained breach.
mike: Rollout plan: 3% -> 15% after 8m -> 40% after 25m -> 100% after 90m. Rollback triggers (short): sustained 5xx >0.3% above baseline for 4m; p95 spike >180ms above baseline for 3m; eval set regression >0.8%.
ops-bot: Reminder: Quiet window policy active. No non-emergency infra changes until 04:00 UTC without exemption. To request exemption post `/exempt request` and include owner approval.
jo: Initial smoke: all endpoints 200, p95 ~140ms (baseline ~125ms), embed parity 99.95%. No errors.
sam: Good. @lina enable canary alert group; @mike keep release owner. If any alert, freeze further roll and post single-line reason + timestamp.
deploy-bot: Canary roll started -> model-service 3% traffic in eu-west-1.
jo: 5m check: stable, small jitter only.
lina: Noted minor increase in cache-miss logs. Filed ticket INF-902, not user-facing.
mike: Scheduling 15% in 8m. If we get noisy cache-miss escalation, we'll pause and triage.
ops-bot: Emergency unfreeze procedure: `/unfreeze approve` by two owners (release + SRE) required. If unfreeze granted, update customer-facing changelog with note.
sam: Final readiness: release owner @mike, QA @jo, SRE @lina, rollback executor @taylor. GO/NO-GO?
mike: GO from release.
jo: GO from QA.
lina: GO from SRE.
deploy-bot: 15% shift scheduled in 8m. Next auto action: `/shift service=model-service to=15% region=eu-west-1 in=8m`
jo: Will post quick 15% summary. Keep thread short updates only. If /rollback used post reason and timestamp.
mike: One more note: if rollback happens we'll target `3.4.2` and run a postmortem if user-impacting.
sam: Thanks team. I'll pin this thread for live ops. Short updates only. :thumbsup:
